name: Typed request resolves into a generated image
looks: A chat input in a product panel receives a typed request for an on-brand hero image, the send button taps, and the agent panel opens to a soft placeholder rectangle with a small pulse. The placeholder cross-fades in place into a finished product photo, warm and styled, exactly filling the space the placeholder held.
build: Chat text types on, cursor blinking; the send action is a 0.9x button click-scale. Placeholder rect pulses opacity 0.85-1 for ~1s, then cross-fades to the pre-sized final image over 300-500ms, no reflow. A small 'working on it' label with a spinner glyph sits above the placeholder until the swap.
sound: Soft typewriter patter under the typed request, a low pulse during the wait, a brighter chime as the image resolves in.
prompt: Show someone typing a plain-language request into a chat panel for an on-brand image; after it sends, hold on a soft pulsing placeholder in an agent panel, then resolve that placeholder in place into the finished, styled image, so the generation reads as happening exactly where the result will live.
